name: N
note: lookahead: show the network the piece after next (queue[1], which the encoding has always thrown away). Read this arm against J, not against G: it is the five feature planes plus one queue plane, so the difference is exactly the queue. If planning for a piece two moves away is what the agent lacks, this is where it shows; the reward, schedule, head, buffer and episodes are G's/J's
